variants.det: keypoint-detector boxes; LODO sacrum, conf >= 0.25; std alphabets
variants.det74: keypoint-detector boxes; LODO sacrum, conf >= 0.74 (cross-device operating point); std alphabets
variants.oracle: truth body boxes; truth sacrum; std alphabets
variants.oracle_dd: oracle with a vertebra box duplicating an earlier one (IoU > 0.9) dropped before counting (--dedupe-boxes); std alphabets

definitions.classifier: the prototype's reported `level` (anchored decode over the blended single-crop + recurrent-head posterior, flip-TTA), the same name every shipped C-ArmLSpine number scores
definitions.coupled: A*(n_i) for bodies with an ordinal from the sacrum, the classifier's name otherwise (no anchor -> unchanged)
definitions.count: the ordinary alphabet at the ordinal (L5 at 1, L4 at 2, ...): the count alone, no classifier; wrong by construction on an L6 spine
definitions.score: S(A) = mean_i log p_i(A(n_i)) over counted bodies, p floored at 1e-9; alphabets sweep_map.alphabet (std: ordinary, L6, T13, both); identical namings are one candidate
definitions.margin: S(A*) - S(ordinary), 0 when ordinary wins; margin_next = S(A*) - S(runner-up)
definitions.anchor: det: the LODO box detector's class-1 box (rx_lodo_carmlspine_1024, C-ArmLSpine never seen), run on the raw frame, conf >= 0.25 (det) or >= 0.74 (det74); oracle: the truth meta's class-1 box
definitions.ordinal: rank of the box centre's projection on the principal axis of all centres, away from the sacrum; a box with IoU > 0.5 to the sacrum box or on its far side has none
definitions.truth: carmlspine_eval.py's match (centre inside the truth body box, IoU >= 0.3, one to one); bodies whose two CBCT labellers disagree carry no level and are not scored, except the three VERIDAH-L6 patients, scored separately under `truth_source = variant_alphabet:L6`
definitions.intervals: 2000-resample percentile bootstrap clustered by case, seed 0
definitions.tau: 5th percentile of margin_next over the other four folds' anchored, fully correct frames of the same variant and field; at least 20 such frames or no margin threshold

other_frames_without_agreed_truth.note: frames whose truth boxes carry no agreed level (the variant CBCTs other than the three VERIDAH-L6 ones); they take part in no accuracy above
